title: How to Generate Assets in This Style?
author: PykeTheTitan
selftext: I really want to go for this low poly art style but ai just doesn't seem capable of creating these assets even tho I chose this because it should be easier to generate from these graphics. GPT 5.6 sol on ultra couldn't make the base character with no clothes, some of the online image to 3d model generators could make some pretty good stuff but weren't able to add the low poly triangles and just smoothed everything over. Do I just learn blender at this point?

comments.author: mallcopsarebastards
comments.body: That's not how these models work. A simpler mesh isn't easier for the AI. The scale of difficulty for the AI is easy=common -> difficult=uncommon. This is an uncommon style for figure models, so it's difficult for the AI to generate.

replies.author: PykeTheTitan
replies.body: yeah that makes sense. I guess my plan is just to keep working on gameplay with whatever shabby models I have, I'm sure in 6 months ai will be able to generate stuff like this cleanly

comments.author: TeeRKee
comments.body: these low poly assets cost like 10$ in unity store

comments.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
comments.body:
Characters is precisely what the AI is not good at yet.

I think your best bet is to generate some sort of image of what you want and use something like meshy to create the 3d model, and then import it in GLB to your project. I had some pretty decent results with this.

replies.author: PykeTheTitan
replies.body: Yeah I think I’m just gonna work with an asset that does the job for now, I’m sure in no time we will have better 3d asset generation through ai

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
I think what is more likely is that they will make the AI better at creating it's own assets with Blender.

Creating a characters from scratch with floating point numbers in javascript probably has to be a bad method to do this. It's not that AI will truly never be able to do this, but it's likely not efficient or optimal.

replies.author: lordpoee
replies.body:
I uploaded your image into Chatgpt 5.6 sol  
then said "Generate art in this style, front and back view."

replies.author: PykeTheTitan
replies.body: That looks sick, but I did intentionally remove some fantasy elements from the characters I generated. I thought it would be really interesting for them to use medieval and fantasy weapons with a more modern and functional twist on what they were wearing. Kind of like a modern backpacker that is prepared to fight fantasy enemies

comments.author: Cool-Chemical-5629
comments.body: I'm vibecoding my custom parametric 3D humanoid character editor. It's not perfect, but when I tested in the game I'm working on, it certainly beats those half broken blocky characters the AI normally generates by default. Neat thing is the AI agent can mass create its own characters with it, so you can see the results pretty soon once it's integrated into the game.
